title: Explain dependency injection
summary: Explain what dependency injection is, why it helps and how service lifetimes work in .NET.

criteria.title: Concept
criteria.description: Explains what dependency injection is and how it differs from creating dependencies inside a class.

levels.description: No answer or a wrong idea of the concept.

Clear definition, inversion of control named, constructor injection explained with an example.

criteria.title: Benefits and trade-offs

criteria.title: Service lifetimes
criteria.description: Knows transient, scoped and singleton, and when each one fits.

criteria.title: Captive dependency
criteria.description: Mentions that a singleton must not depend on a scoped service, or explains the problem when asked.
